verses: To the chief Musician, on strings, Of David.
Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
From the end of the earth I will cry to Thee, when my heart faints. lead me to the rock that is too high for me.
For Thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
I will abide in Thy tent for ever: I will trust in the covert of Thy wings. (Sela.)
For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast granted the heritage of those who fear Thy name.
Prolong the king’s life: may his years be as many generations.
May he be enthroned before God for ever: O appoint love and truth, that they may preserve him.
So will I sing praise to Thy name for ever, as I perform my vows day by day.
